QuestInfo.name: [Gold Beach] Fun With the Son
QuestInfo.0: Let Little Richie know that Gold Richie invited you here.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to #b#e#p1082000##n#k, the manager of Gold Beach Resort.

0.0: Are you still here?\r\n#L0##bGold Richie invited me to this resort.#l\n#k
0.1: Oh, well good for you. My daddy built it for us. Lil Willy and Teeny Jenny seem to like it, but I think it's a bore.\r\n#L0##bWhere should I stay?#l\n#k
0.2: I don't know or care. It's time for Lil Willy's afternoon diamond diving session... Go talk to the manager, #p1082000#.

yes.0: Who is #p1082000#? I don't really know. He's got a mustache or something.

no.0: I'd show you around myself, but... well, no I wouldn't.

1.0: Busy, busy, busy... Yes? What do you need?

npc.0: His name is #p1082000# and he has a mustache. Leave me be!
